document.title: Operator Health Check — 2026-03-11 20:51 UTC
document.content:
# Operator Health Check

**Time:** 2026-03-11 20:51 UTC

## Summary
- PM2: 12 online, 1 stopped (`whisper`)
- Docker: most containers healthy/up; issues on `lidaros-frontend` (unhealthy), `omiximo-email-automation` (unhealthy), `langfuse_langfuse-web_1` (restarting)
- Disk: `/` at 69% used (within threshold)
- RAM: 11.1 GB used / 27.5 GB total; ~16.4 GB available
- GPU: RTX 4090 present, 20.5 GB / 24.6 GB VRAM in use by `VLLM::EngineCore`; no active GPU load spike
- OpenClaw gateway: reachable on `127.0.0.1:18789`, but `openclaw gateway status` reports systemd runtime inactive/sub dead and service config out of date

## Notes
- No disk or RAM threshold alerts triggered
- Gateway appears to be running under PM2 (`openclaw-gateway` online) while the user-level systemd unit is stale/inactive
- `openclaw gateway status` also reports group allowlist configuration warnings for Telegram and WhatsApp accounts

## Recommended Follow-up
1. Check whether `whisper` is intentionally stopped; restart if it should be serving
2. Inspect Docker logs/healthchecks for `lidaros-frontend`, `omiximo-email-automation`, and `langfuse_langfuse-web_1`
3. Normalize OpenClaw supervision path (PM2 vs systemd) and reinstall the systemd unit if systemd is still intended
4. Review group allowlist settings if group message handling is expected
